body_markdown:
**Ontop does not offer EOR. This guide explains how employer of record services work, and when a contractor of record is the simpler option for global teams.**


‍


## **What is an Employer Of Record (EOR)?**


‍


Hiring an international employee can be difficult and time-consuming. You'll need to set up contracts, deal with different legal systems, and provide benefits like health care or vacation days—the list goes on!


‍


But all this hassle is a thing of the past if you use EOR services, which enable companies in one country to hire someone else from another nation without having them become independent contractors by themselves first; it's easy as pie for your company because everything happens online.


‍


An Employer of Record (EOR) is a third-party organization that hires and pays an employee on behalf of another company and takes responsibility for all formal employment tasks, allowing you to have a global team in countries where you don't have a legal entity.


‍


## **What does an EOR do?**


‍


With an EOR (Employer Of Record), the client company hands over employment responsibilities to a third party that handles[payroll solution](https://www.getontop.com/solutions/global-contractor-payroll) and administrative tasks. An EOR also ensure compliance with local laws and may conduct talent searches or vet candidates on behalf of their clients.


‍


The EOR agrees with the client to employ a worker and act as their legal employer. The work is performed for the client, who benefits from it, but the EOR is legally responsible for complying with the obligations of an employer.


‍


## **When to use an EOR?**


‍


### There are many reasons to use an employer of record when looking for employees:


• Your company is seeking for expansion and wants people on the ground in another country


• You need compliance with local labor laws


• You want full-time workers without opening up a subsidiary


• You want significant savings downline while still meeting compliance demands


‍


## **Why use Employer Of Record?**


‍


The idea of working with a reputable business partner offers many advantages. Employing an EOR allows the company to manage its time efficiently.


‍


### The client can experience immediate effects on:


• Costs


• HR operations


• Employee benefits


• Local payroll


• Compliance issues relating to the domestic and internationally applicable laws


‍


For teams that do not need employees, a contractor of record model delivers many of the same benefits at a lower cost.[See how Ontop works as an EOR alternative](https://www.getontop.com/solutions/eor-alternative-for-contractors) .


‍


## **The Role of an Employer of Record**


‍


Employer records are a business entity based on a governmental entity placed in a governmental relationship between employees and employers.


‍


Therefore, despite its duties, the Employment and Labor Commission does not have the responsibility to participate in daily work activities.


‍


‍

‍


You can also see benefits in profitability, productivity, performance, engagement and even retention, facts that would help your business growth.
